component.name: Plasma Label Creator
component.summary: Design and print labels on DYMO and ZPL label printers

description.p: Plasma Label Creator designs and prints labels on DYMO LabelWriter and LabelManager printers and on ZPL label printers such as Zebra and Altec. It opens and saves .label files and DYMO address books.

ul.li: Text, addresses, barcodes and QR codes, pictures, shapes, counters and dates
Fields filled from questions asked when printing, or a label per row of a CSV, spreadsheet or database
Label types for every DYMO model, tape labels, and custom sizes for ZPL printers
A print-only mode with forms, for people who only print
Versions of labels, a print history and shared counters
An automation service that prints jobs from folders and over HTTP

description.p: Desktop integration, each part optional: file types for label files and address books, the app's own icons, label thumbnails in Dolphin, "Print Label" in Dolphin's right-click menu, launcher keywords and actions, and this metadata. Installing system-wide or for one user is documented.
Add-ons: optional plugins that add to the app, such as working with a team's labels on a server.

Print conditions, text that grows to fit with anchored objects, guidelines, polygons, stars, arrows and SVG drawings, a label per row from data, header and trailer labels, print density, darkness and speed per label.
Print-only mode with forms, label versions, print history, printer status, settings, export with the label's outline and the automation service.
